name: agent-dispatch
description: Dispatch coding work to external agent CLIs (codex, agy/Gemini, claude) behind a preflight → timeout → completion-marker → hard-revert safety net, drive a live agent TUI over tmux/cmux, and run the tiered peer-review gate — pick the reviewer lenses, brief them identically, optionally run a different-model pass, and leave a durable review log. Bare-PATH CLIs plus skills for worktree-isolated dispatch, bootstrap validation, agent-session stubbing, driving live agent sessions, and the tiered peer-review gate (build, design, and requirements modes).
